intro: Tanzania is a presidential republic, a union of the mainland and semi-autonomous Zanzibar.

chapters.title: How it works
text: The president is elected for five years. The ruling party, Chama Cha Mapinduzi, has governed since independence. Zanzibar has its own president and parliament. Rights groups criticised the 2025 election, after which security forces killed many protesters.

chapters.title: Stability
text: For decades Tanzania avoided the ethnic conflicts of some neighbours.
